description.en: Full-duplex voice for the DSH Web UI: tap-to-toggle or hold-to-talk dictation (send key or Ctrl) with a live caption, host-side SenseVoice ASR via sherpa-onnx, sentence-by-sentence spoken replies, and true barge-in where speaking interrupts playback and the running turn. Includes NLMS acoustic echo cancellation using the page's own TTS playback as the echo reference. No API key.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 全双工语音对话：点按切换或按住说话（发送键或 Ctrl）并显示实时字幕，宿主端 SenseVoice（sherpa-onnx）转写，回复按句流式朗读，开口说话即打断播放与正在运行的回合（真 barge-in）。内置 NLMS 声学回声消除，以页面自身 TTS 播放为回声参考。无需 API key。
